title: Male borrowers who include the loan amount in local currency may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who explicitly state their age in the pitch text may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who explicitly mention limited financial resources as a barrier may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who provide detailed descriptions of family size and children's education may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention being a widow with children may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention saving money in conjunction with helping the environment may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who include a note identifying the person in the photo may fund faster.
Pitches that list specific quantities or types of agricultural inputs predict faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who explicitly claim to be deserving or committed to repayment may fund faster.
Female borrowers who specify the number of years their business has been operating may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who provide specific details about their children fund faster.
